name: Room of Requirement - Review Lab
postCreateCommand: set -euo pipefail; export PATH="/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:$PATH"; echo '==> Installing GitHub CLI and gocryptfs'; brew install gh gocryptfs; echo '==> Trusting Josh Review dev tap'; brew trust --tap joshyorko/review-dev; brew tap joshyorko/review-dev; brew update; echo '==> Installing latest Bluefin Review dev package'; brew install joshyorko/review-dev/bluefin-review-dev; echo '==> Preparing Review source checkout from upstream main'; mkdir -p "$HOME/src"; if [ ! -d "$HOME/src/review/.git" ]; then git clone https://github.com/joshyorko/review.git "$HOME/src/review"; fi; cd "$HOME/src/review"; git remote get-url upstream >/dev/null 2>&1 || git remote add upstream https://github.com/projectbluefin/review.git; git fetch upstream main; git switch -C main upstream/main; if ! command -v fuse2fs >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo '==> Building fuse2fs for Wolfi'; sudo apk add --no-cache build-base git pkgconf fuse3-dev linux-headers autoconf automake libtool; tmp="$(mktemp -d)"; git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/tytso/e2fsprogs.git "$tmp/e2fsprogs"; mkdir -p "$tmp/e2fsprogs/build"; cd "$tmp/e2fsprogs/build"; ../configure; make -j"$(nproc)"; sudo install -m 0755 ./misc/fuse2fs /usr/local/bin/fuse2fs; rm -rf "$tmp"; fi; echo; echo '=== Review source ==='; git -C "$HOME/src/review" log -1 --oneline; echo; echo '=== Installed Review package ==='; brew list --versions joshyorko/review-dev/bluefin-review-dev; echo; echo '=== Review runtime ==='; command -v gh; command -v apptainer; command -v squashfuse; command -v gocryptfs; command -v fuse2fs; command -v bluefin; echo; if [ -e /dev/fuse ]; then echo '/dev/fuse: READY'; else echo 'WARNING: /dev/fuse is missing'; fi; if [ -e /dev/kvm ]; then echo '/dev/kvm: READY'; else echo 'WARNING: /dev/kvm is missing'; fi; echo; echo 'Bootstrap complete.'; echo 'Next: gh auth login'; echo 'Review source: ~/src/review (upstream/main)'; echo 'Run: bluefin review projectbluefin/review'
